metadata.host: SE.gates_off for off_none/oracle/memory; on_none and B.build comparison estimators unchanged
metadata.update: Memory: every 6 actual control ticks when valid, no block or 24-tick hold; original estimators called each host request
metadata.baseline_rate: on_none/off_none and adopted D4/Rossi-ID/Kalman/MHE remain untouched; oracle at every host request
metadata.likelihood: IMM/EWA: innovation variance prior+(sigma/k)^2, likelihood power 1/4; gains use prior+4*(sigma/k)^2
metadata.parameters: F2 factories and constants unchanged; actual dt and path; no tuning
metadata.oracle: Window output 1.2*instantaneous true |K(20.8)|, sigma=0, chi=0, info=1; through unchanged gates-off host including CENTRE and k_bar decline bound; not a feasible estimator
metadata.truth: 0.1 s centered boxcar of ln|K(20.8)| within contact runs for detection ONLY; exact unsmoothed ell for offset, lag, local error, raw log ratio and plateau
metadata.transitions: t>=1, contact, abs(dell/dt)>.2/s, merge subthreshold gaps <.1s, abs(endpoint delta)>=.15; large>=.3
metadata.prior_contact_loss: After first true contact, any true-contact loss before transition start excludes that transition; initial no-contact acquisition is not a loss
metadata.catastrophe: Episode peak true axial force after t>=1 >36.5N: retained and listed, excluded from all transition aggregates and paired comparisons; plateau all-episode and noncatastrophic versions both stored
metadata.local_offset: Median of own error on full .5s before start; otherwise eligible episode median; counted separately per channel
metadata.lag: Exhaustive grid 0:.008:1.496 plus 1.5s; linear interpolation of exact log truth; invalid lags omitted; ties choose smallest
metadata.settling: First start at/after t1 with .2s continuous in-band; <=.1 log unit, cap2s; end-of-episode censor horizon recorded
metadata.force: True axial force log[:,18]-8; fourth-order Butterworth 15-35Hz zero-phase full-episode offline filter; interval band RMS / pooled episode plateau band RMS
metadata.force_recovery: First start at/after t1 with abs(F-8)<=.5N for .2s, cap2s; next transitions do not reset horizon; overlap counted
metadata.matched_plateau: Nearest contiguous SE plateau interval of identical tick length in same episode (ties earlier); no stitched ticks or cross-episode substitution; virtual t1 at same offset, missing matches counted
metadata.distributions: Each transition has equal weight; med/P90 incl capped censored times. Signed negative extremes also P10; under_magnitude=-min(error), so P90 is adverse tail. Plateau distributions give each episode equal weight.
